defects: MAJOR voice2txt/context.py:201-205 (capture_selection, T14 code, wave D): when the target app writes the Ctrl+C selection to the clipboard after the 0.4 s timeout, the function returns ('', True) immediately; the late write then leaves the user's selection in the clipboard and the saved text is never restored, while restored=True is reported. Repro (auditor late_clip.py, Tk target delaying its clipboard write): delays 50/200/350 ms -> selection captured and clipboard restored 3/3; delays 500/700/1000 ms -> selection '' and clipboard left as the selection 3/3 (restored_to_prior false). The project's own check_wave_d.py hit it in 1 of 6 runs (cross_process.selection_obtained false, clipboard_restored_after_capture false). Contradicts USER_MANUAL.md:130 ('讀完立刻把剪貼簿還原'). Fix: on timeout keep watching GetClipboardSequenceNumber for a grace window (e.g. 1.5-2 s, off the Tk thread) and, if it advances, restore the saved CF_UNICODETEXT (only if the sequence changed once since the injected Ctrl+C); report restored=False/'late' instead of True on timeout; consider a 0.8-1 s timeout; add a delayed-responder real check like the auditor's; document the residual in USER_MANUAL/STATUS 已知限制.
